student_judgment: Yes—run the LLM scan on unclassified columns (the "belt and suspenders" approach): regex catches 90% instantly and cheap, but LLM on the remaining 10% is mandatory insurance against abbreviated/non-standard PII names slipping through; the cost of a compliance breach (SEBI fines + reputational damage) vastly exceeds the LLM API cost, making this risk/cost tradeoff non-negotiable in regulated fintech.
